If your Blundstones don’t work out, you have a few options:

Return for a refund:

Free returns within 30 days of purchase/order.
Boots must be unworn, in original condition/packaging, tried on carpet only.
Start in our Returns Portal using your order number and email, then follow the prompts.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically process within 8 business days after we receive your return, plus up to 10 business days for your bank to post it.

Order something different instead of an exchange:

We don’t offer exchanges, but you can return your boots for a refund and then place a new order for a different size or style whenever you’re ready.

If you catch it early:

Within 60 minutes of placing your order, you can cancel it via the link in your confirmation email or through My Account. After that window, the order will ship and you’d use the return process if it doesn’t work out.

So, if it doesn’t work out, you can either cancel shortly after ordering, or return your unworn boots within 30 days for a full refund and then reorder a different pair if you’d like.
